map.Pp 过程性能计算器 使用指南: Pp Process Performance Calculator User Guide
map.Pp 过程性能计算器求过程总变异下的性能指数（对比规格宽度），适合长期过程能力评: The Pp process performance calculator gives the performance index under total process variation (compared with the specification width), suited to long-term capability assessment and paired analysis with Ppk.
map.用整体标准差（长期）评估过程实际性能 Pp，反映包含特殊原因在内的总波动能否满足: Use the overall (long-term) standard deviation to evaluate actual process performance Pp, showing whether total variation including special causes meets the specification.
map.与 Cp 对照（Pp 用整体σ、Cp 用组内σ），两者差距大说明过程存在特殊原因: Compare with Cp (Pp uses overall sigma, Cp uses within-group sigma); a large gap means special causes are present and the process is not yet stable.
map.长期供货质量审核时作为客户验收的性能指标。: Used as the customer's acceptance performance metric in long-term supply quality audits.
map.：Pp = (USL − LSL) / (6σ_long)，σ_long 为基于: Pp = (USL - LSL) / (6 sigma_long), where sigma_long is the overall standard deviation from all historical data (including special-cause variation). The thresholds match Cp: 1.33 or above is sufficient, below 1.00 insufficient. Pp is usually at most Cp because overall variation is never smaller than within-group variation.
map.：规格 USL=10.05、LSL=9.95，长期整体σ_long=0.015：: With USL = 10.05, LSL = 9.95 and overall sigma_long = 0.015: Pp = (10.05-9.95)/(6x0.015) = 0.10/0.09 = about 1.111. If within-group sigma = 0.01 (giving Cp = 1.667), then Pp (1.111) < Cp (1.667), and the gap indicates special causes disturbing the process and stability needing improvement.
map.Pp 和 Cp 怎么选？: How Do I Choose Between Pp and Cp?
map.Cp/Ppk 用组内标准差，代表『短期/固有』能力，前提是过程已受控；Pp/Pp: Cp and Ppk use the within-group standard deviation and represent short-term / inherent capability, on the premise that the process is in control; Pp and Ppk use the overall standard deviation and represent long-term / actual performance. Supplier audits often ask for both: a process is truly good only if it is both in control and capable over the long run.
map.Pp 小于 Cp 说明什么？: What Does Pp Below Cp Mean?
map.说明整体波动大于组内波动，存在可识别的特殊原因（如换班差异、设备漂移、来料波动）: This means overall variation exceeds within-group variation, so identifiable special causes exist (shift differences, equipment drift, incoming material variation); stabilize the process with SPC control first and only then talk about capability, otherwise the capability index will be inflated.
